tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukuthi iSichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wobulungiswa Bezingane wezi-2018 sethulwe ePhalamende.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o fetoša Molao wa Toka ya Bana wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 2008) ka nepo ya go lekodišiša mengwaga ya fasefase yeo ngwana a ka bonwago bjalo ka yo a dirilego bosenyi ka go e oketša go tloga go ye 10 go fihla go ye Molaokakanywa o tšwela pele go phethagatša ditokelo tša bana bao ba tshetšego molao.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wobulungiswa Bezingane, wezi-2008 (uMthetho ongunombolo 75 wezi-2008) ukuze kubuyekezwe iminyaka yobudala ephansi yokubekwa icala lobugebengu ngokuthi ikhushulwe isuswa eminyakeni eyi-10 iye eminyakeni eyi-12.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o aroganya gape taba ya maswanedi a go dira bosenyi ga ngwana go phamošo, ka go tloša senyakwa sa go kgonthišiša gore ngwana o dirile bosenyi mabakeng a phamošo le dinyakišišo tša mathomong.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uthatha izinyathelo ezithe xaxa ekuvikeleni amalungelo ezingane eziphule umthetho.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše go romelwa ga Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Bofofiši bja Setšhaba wa 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: Futhi lo Mthethosivivinywa uqeda ukuxhunyaniswa kodaba lwamandla okwenza isenzo sobugebengu nokunikezwa isigwebo sokufakwa kwesaphulamthetho ngaphansi kohlelo lwesijeziso esihlukile esikhundleni sokugqunywa ejele, ngokuthi kususwe umbandela wokuthi kuboniswe ubufakazi obuqanda ikhanda ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo sokufakwa kwesaphulamthetho ngaphansi kohlelo lwesijeziso esihlukile kanye nokwenziwa kophenyo olwandulela ukuqulwa kwecala.

src: Molaokakanywa wo, wo o fetošago Molao wa Bofofiši bja Setšhaba wa 2009 (Molao wa bo 13 wa 2009), o tla maatlafatša polokego ya bofofiši, tšhireletšego le ditlhako tša taolo tša tšhireletšo ya tikologo go netefatša gore go ba le tšwelopele ya go ya go ile le seemo se sekaone ka intastering ya bofofiši bja setšhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa, ochibiyela uMthetho Wezokuhamba Ngezindiza, wezi-2009 (uMthetho ongunombolo 13 wezi-2009), uzoqinisa izinhlaka zemithetho elawula ezokuphepha emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, nokuvikeleka kanye nokuvikelwa kwemvelo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukusimama nozinzo embonini yezokuhamba ngezindiza.

src: Se se tla netefatša gore Afrika Borwa e tšwela pele go fihlelela ditlamego tša yona tša boditšhabatšhaba ka lekaleng la bofofiši bja setšhaba, leo le maatlafatšago thekgo go tlhabollo ya ekonomi ya rena bjalo ka sehlohleletši sa kgwebišano, boeti le tlhomo ya mešomo tšeo di oketšegilego.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokuthobela izibopho zamazwe ngamazwe emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, okuyinto ezoqinisa ukwesekwa kwentuthuko yezomnotho yaleli lizwe futhi kuholele ekukhuphukeni kwezinga nomthamo wezohwebo, ezokuvakasha kanye nokuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o hlagiša gore, gareng ga tše dingwe, go be le boipušo bja tshepedišo ka go dinyakišišo tša dikotsi tša difofane le tša ditiragalo tša go amana le tšona, le go phošolla go se swane le ditlamorago tša go se kgahliše.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela futhi, phakathi kokunye, ukuqhutshwa ngokuzimela kophenyo lwezingozi nezigameko eziphathelene nezindiza, kanye nokulungiswa kwezingxenye zomthetho ezinokuphikisana nokungahambelani okuthile kanye nobuthakathaka.

src: Ditiragalo tše di tlago.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Beke ya Thusong Service Centre.
tgt: Iviki lama-Thusong Service Centre.

src: Ka gare ga tikologo ya Kgwedi ya Tirelo ya Setšhaba, Beke ya ngwaga ka ngwaga ya Thusong Service Centre go tloga ka la 17 go fihla ka la 21 Lewedi 2018 ka fase ga morero wa: “Thuma Mina: Re Iša Ditirelo tša Setšhaba Bathong”, e fana ka sefala se sengwe sa gore mmušo o iše ditirelo tša setšhaba bathong.
tgt: Njengoba lenzeka ngaphansi kweNyanga Yezemisebenzi Kahulumeni, iViki lama-Thusong Service Centre elibanjwa minyaka yonke kusukela mhla ziyi-17 kuya kumhla zingama-21 kuMandulo 2018 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Thuma Mina: Sihambisa Izinsizakalo Zikahulumeni Kubantu”, lihlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi uhulumeni ahambise izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kubantu.

src: Mafelo a Thusong Service Centre ke mafelo a go etelwa ke setšhaba a go fihlelela ditirelo le tshedimošo ya mmušo, gomme mafelo a 133 a Thusong Service Centre nageng ka bophara ke mafelo a kholofelo, a phihlelelo, a tharollo leswa, a tekatekano le kaonafatšo go bao ba beetšwego thoko mo nakong ye e fetilego go tlhabollo ya ekonomi ya setšhaba ka kakaretšo.
tgt: Ama-Thusong Service Centre yizikhungo ezingontozonke lapho kutholakala khona izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kanye nolwazi, futhi lama-Thusong Service Centre ayi-133 atholakala ezweni lonkana ayizizinda zethemba, ukufinyelela, ukulungisa izinto ezingahanjiswanga ngendlela efanele esikhathini esedlule, ikhwalithi kanye nokuhlonyiswa kwalabo bantu ababencishwe amathuba esikhathini esedlule ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu kuleli.

src: Mmušo o šomela go hloma Lenaneo la Taolo ya Methaladi leo le tlogo fokotša lebaka la kelo ya tshepedišo go kgontšha go fokotša nako yeo batho ba e tšeago ba emetše ditirelo.
tgt: Uhulumeni wenza imizamo yokufaka uHlelo Lokulawula Imigqa Yokulinda Izinsizakalo oluzonciphisa izinqubo nemidanti eminingi okumele ilandelwe, ukuze kuncishiswe nesikhathi sokulinda.

src: Lenaneo le le tlo hlongwa ka mafelong ka moka nageng ka bophara go lebeletšwe kudu gape kgokaganyo le theknolotši ya tshedimošo le dikgokagano (ICT), yeo e lego sekgontšhi sa kabo ya ditirelo.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzofakwa kuzo zonke izizinda zikahulumeni ezweni lonkana futhi kuzogxilwa nasekuxhumaneni ngobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT), okuyinto eyenza kube lula ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni.

src: Khonferentshe ya Lefase ya Dikgokagano tša Megala ya ITU ya 2018.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-ITU Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yamazwe Ngamazwe yowezi-2018.

src: Kabinete e amogela go swarwa ga Khonferentshe ya Lefase ya Dikgokagano tša Megala ya 2018 ya Mokgatlo wa Dikgokagano tša Megala wa Boditšhabatšhaba (ITU) ka Durban go tloga ka la 9 go fihla ka la 13 Lewedi 2018, ka fase ga morero wa “Boitlhamelo bja Tlhabollo ye Theknolotši ya Titšithale”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyayamukela iNgqungquthela Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yenhlangano Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Emhlabeni (i-ITU) yowezi-2018 ezobanjelwa eThekwini kusukela mhla ziyisi-9 kuya kumhla ziyi-13 kuMandulo 2018, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Ukuqhamuka Nemiqondo Emisha Ukuthuthukisa Nokusebenzisa Ubuxhakaxhaka Besimanjemanje”.

src: Tiragalo ye, yeo e tlago ka Afrika la mathomo, e fana ka sebaka sa go kgatha tema mo go oketšegilego ga dinaga tša Afrika go thuša ICT ka Afrika bjalo ka mohlohleletši wa tlhabollo le boitlhamelo.
tgt: Lo mcimbi, oza eNingizimu Afrika okokuqala ngqa, uhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi amazwe akhuphule izinga lokubamba kwawo iqhaza ukuze kuqiniswe futhi kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kwe-ICT e-Afrika njengensiza ezoletha intuthuko nokuqanjwa kwezinhlelo nezinsizakusebenza ezintsha.

src: Khonferentshe ye ya ngwaga ka ngwaga e tsenelwa ke baromiwa ba go feta ba 9 000 go tšwa lefaseng ka bophara, fao e lego gore baetapele ba mmušo le ba diintasteri ba utolla le go tseba dibaka tša peeletšo le ditiro tše kaone tša tlhabollo ya ekonomi ya setšhaba ka go diriša ICMerero ye bohlokwa yeo e tlogo ahlaahlwa e akaretša: 5G ya tlhabollo ya theknolotši ya tša titšithale, go dirišana ka ga tšhireletšego ya inthaneteng, ditirelo tša ditšhelete tša titšithale le disathalaete tša tlhabollo ya theknolotši ya tša titšithale.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebanjwa minyaka yonke iheha izithunywa ezingaphezu kwezi-9 000 ezivela emhlabeni wonke jikelele, lapho ohulumeni kanye nabaholi bemboni becubungula futhi bahlonze amathuba nezinkambiso ezingungqaphambili zokuthuthukisa inhlalomnotho ngokusebenzisa i-ICIzihloko ezisemqoka okuzobhungwa ngazo zibandakanya: ukusetshenziswa kwe-5G ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje, ukubambisana ekuqinisekiseni ukuvikeleka kwe-inthanethi, izinsizakalo zezimali ezihlinzekwa ngobuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje kanye namasathelayithi okuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje.

src: Khonferentshe ya Lefase ya Dikgokagano tša Megala ya ITU ya 2018 e swarwa ka nako yeo Afrika Borwa e phethagatšago diprotšeke tše bohlokwa tša bosetšhaba tšeo di akaretšago Leano la Bosetšhaba la Mmušo la e-Government leo le lebeletšego kudu phetošo ya tša titšithale ya ditirelo tša mmušo le Leanothekgo la Bosetšhaba la ICT ya Dikgwebopotlana, Dikgwebo tša Magareng le Dikgwebo tše Nnyane (SMME), leo le nyakago go lokolla bokgoni bja lefapha la ICT ya di-SMME la Afrika Borwa.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-ITU Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo Yamazwe Ngamazwe yowezi-2018 isingathwa ngesikhathi lapho iNingizimu Afrika iqalisa imiklamo kazwelonke esemqoka kakhulu, ebandakanya iQhingasu Likazwelonke Lokuqhuba Umsebenzi Kahulumeni Nge-inthanethi eligxile ekuletheni uguquko lokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi nobuxhakaxhaka besimanjemanje uma kuhlinzekwa izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kanye neQhingasu Likazwelonke Lokweseka Amabhizinisi e-ICT Asafufusa (ama-SMME), elihlose ukuvula amathuba okukhula nokudlondlobala komkhakha wama-SMME e-ICT eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ditlabelo tše di hloma seemo seo se kgontšhago kgolo ya ka mo lefapheng le le go netefatša gore di tšwela pele go šomišwa go ya go ile.
tgt: Lawa mathuluzi akha isimo esizovumela ukukhula kwalo mkhakha futhi ukwazi nokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwawo nokuqhubeka isikhathi eside.

src: Melaetša.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e lebiša mahloko a yona a magolo go:lapa leo le lego mahlokong le setšhaba ka moka sa Yunibesithi ya Theknolotši ya Tshwane ka morago ga lehu la Katlego Monareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo:emndenini osemanzini kanye nomphakathi wonkana weNyuvesi Yezobuchwepheshe yase-Tshwane kulandela ukudlula emhlabeni kuka-Katlego Monareng.

src: Kabinete e ipiletša go batho gore ba gobe maswafo ge dinyakišišo tša maphodisa di tšwela pele go netefatša gore mang goba mang yo a rwelego maikarabelo go lehu leo le bego le se la emelwa o lebana le maatla a molao ka WEBTOKEN lapa le bagwera ba batho ba seswai bao ba hlokofetšego ka mothuthupong wa ka femeng ya dibetša ya Denel ka Somerset West ka Kapa Bodikela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abantu ukuba behlise imimoya ngenkathi amaphoyisa enza uphenyo lwawo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi umbulali ubhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: baratiwa ba bao ba hlokofetšego ka mollong wo o bakilego mahu wo o hlagilego ka moagong wo o bego o šomišwa mmogo ke dikgoro tša Mmušo wa Profense ya Gauteng tša Maphelo, Madulo a Batho le Pušo ya Tirišano.
tgt: emndenini nabangani babantu abayisishiyagalombili ababhubhe ekuqhumeni okwenzeke efemini yezikhali yakwa-Denel e-Somerset West eNtshonalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e lebogišitše batho ba Zimbabwe ge ba atlegile go fetogela ka mmušong o moswa wo o etilwego pele ke Mopresidente Emmerson Mnangagwa, yo a hlomamišitšwego semmušo ka la 26 Phato 2018.
tgt: izihlobo nabangani babantu abashone enhlekeleleni yomlilo oqubuke esakhiweni esisetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela yiminyango kaHulumeni Wesifundazwe sase-Gauteng, okunguMnyango Wezempilo, Owezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu kanye Nowezokuphatha Ngokubambisana.

src: Kabinete e thekga boikgafo bja Mopresidente Ramaphosa bja go šomišana mmogo le Zimbabwe ka nepo ya go maatlafatša dikamano tša histori, tša sepolotiki le tša borwarre, go tiišetšwa kudu go maatlafatša tirišano ka ga ekonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele abantu baseZimbabwe ngoguquko olwenzeke ngempumelelo lokuthatha izintambo kukahulumeni omusha oholwa nguMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa, owagcotshwa mhla zingama-26 kuNcwaba 2018.

src: Kabinete e reta Lekgotla la Dinyakišišo ka ga Mahlale le Diintasteri, kudukudu banyakišiši ba yona ba basadi, ge ba dirile dinyakišišo ka ga maphelo ka nepo ya go kaonafatša lenaneo la tlhokomelo ya maphelo la ka mo nageng.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa wahlanganyela nabanye abaholi base-Afrika eHarare ukuyozibonela ngawakhe ngenkathi kubanjwe lo mkhosi.

src: setlabelo sa go utolla bolwetši bja swikiri sa go diša maemo a swikiri ka mading ka go sekaseka mohemo (ii) tšweletšo ya diphropayothiki go tla go šomišwa ka tšweletšong ya dikgogo tša nama, hlapi ya dusky-cob le abalone, tšeo di tlago thuša ka tšweletšong ya ditšweletšwa tša tlhago tša diphoofolo, tše di hlokago dianthipayothiki, dikhemikhale le dihlohleletši tša kgodišo (iii) le go tšwela pele ka dinyakišišo tša sele ya setemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakweseka ukuzibophezela kukaMongameli Ramaphosa ekutheni uzosebenzisana ngokubambisana okukhulu nelizwe laseZimbabwe ukuze kuphuculwe ubudlelwano bomlando, ezepolitiki kanye nobungani obuphakathi kwalawa mazwe, futhi okuwubudlelwano obuzogxila ikakhulukazi ekuqinisekiseni ubambiswano lwezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e lebogiša gape Ngaka Evodia Setati, monyakišišimogolo ka go Kgoro ya Dithutamahlale tša Diterebe le Dibeine, yo a thopilego Sefoka sa Bommamahlale ba go Hlomphega ka go Difoka tša ngwaga le ngwaga tša Basadi bao ba šomago ka go tša Mahlale tše di swerwego ka Polokwane ka la 23 Phato 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawuncoma impela uMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezesayensi Nezimboni, ikakhulukazi abacwaningi besifazane, maqondana nocwaningo lwezempilo olwenziwayo njengamanje ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa nokwenza ngcono uhlelo losizo nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kuleli.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la 19 Lewedi 2018 ka Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-19 kuMandulo 2018, e-Union Buildings, ePitoli.

src: Ekonomi.
tgt: Izindaba Ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e amogela tshepišo ye e filwego ke ba kgwebo ya go romela diphrofešenale tša lekala la phraebete ka mmušong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isiphakamiso somkhakha wamabhizinisi sokuphakanyiswa kwamagama ongoti bomkhakha ozimele abazolekelela uhulumeni.

src: Se se tšweletše ka kopanong ya boitokišetšo ye e bego e swerwe ke Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa le baetapele ba kgwebo, baromiwa bao ba kgethegilego ba tša peeletšo le Maitekelo ka Bahlankedibagolophethiši (di-CEO), pele ga Seboka sa Mešomo seo se tlago le Khonferentshe ka ga Dipeeletšo.
tgt: Lokhu kuvele emhlangamweni wokulungiselela obanjwe nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa nabaholi bamabhizinisi, amanxusa otshalomali akhethekile kanye nenhlangano yabaphathi abakhulu bakuleli, i-CEO Initiative, ngaphambi kweNgqungquthela Yezemisebenzi kanye neNkomfa Yotshalomali ezobanjwa khona maduze nje.

src: Kopano ye e kwane gore go tsoga ga ekonomi ya Afrika Borwa go nyaka go tsenya tirišong ga tšhoganetšo ga maano a go hlohleletša ekonomi le dipeakanyoleswa tša kgodišo ya ekonomi tše di tshepišitšwego.
tgt: Lo mhlangano wavumelana ngazwi linye ukuthi ukuvuselelwa komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kudinga ukuthi kuqaliswe ngokushesha iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho kanye nezinguquko ezithenjisiwe zokuthuthukisa umnotho.

src: Ditšhišinyo le tšona di ile tša ahlaahlwa ka nepo ya go hloma maitekelo a tlhabollo ya mananeokgoparara ao a akaretšago thušo ya ditšhelete ka lefapheng la phraebete le botsebi bja kabo ya ditirelo.
tgt: Kwaxoxiswana futhi nangeziphakamiso zokuheha uxhasomali oluvela emkhakheni ozimele kanjalo nobungoti nobuchwepheshe bokuqhuba umsebenzi obuvela kulo mkhakha.

src: Lesolo la dipeeletšo.
tgt: Umkhankaso wotshalomali.

src: Kabinete e amogela gape lesolo la dipeeletšo la go leba Japane leo le etilwego pele ke Kgoro ya Kgwebišano le Diintasteri (dti).
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawamukela futhi nomkhankaso oholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni wokuyonxenxa utshalomali kwelase-Japan.

src: Lesolo le le nyaka go goketša US$100 pilione ya dipeeletšo ka ekonoming ya Afrika Borwa mo mengwageng ye e tlago ye mehlano.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukuheha utshalomali oluyimali engamabhiliyoni e-US$ ayi-100 oluzongena emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka emihlanu ezayo.

src: Japane e bile molekane wa lebaka le letelele go dinaga tše 10 tša Godimo tšeo di dirišanago le Afrika Borwa, gomme dikhamphani tša yona tše di fetago tše 140 di dira kgwebo ka mo nageng ya rena, yeo e bonwago bjalo ka lefelo le legolo la tšweletšo ka mo seleteng sa Afrika.
tgt: I-Japan ngelinye lamazwe ayi-10 aphuma phambili asetshale izimali eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi eside, njengoba kunezinkampani zayo ezingaphezu kwe-140 eziqhuba ibhizinisi ezweni lethu, okuyizwe elibonwa njengesizinda sezokukhiqiza kulesi sifunda sase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e hlohleletša dikhamphani go beeletša le go godiša dikgwebo tša tšona ka mo Afrika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyazikhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi zitshale izimali eNingizimu Afrika futhi ziphinde zelule umsebenzi webhizinisi eziwenzayo kuleli.

src: Mananeo a tlhahlo.
tgt: Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tsebagatšwa semmušo ga protšeke ya tlhahlo ye e jago R22 milione ye e hlomilwego ke Tona ya Bašomi, Mohumagadi Mildred Oliphant, yeo e tlago hloma mešomo ka lefapheng la bofofiši, la go tipela ka meetseng a lewatle ka nepo ya go dira kgwebo le la temo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukwethulwa komklamo wokuqeqesha, odle imali ezizigidi ezingama-22 zamarandi, owethulwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, uNkz Mildred Oliphant, ozovula amathuba omsebenzi emkhakheni wezokuhamba ngezindiza, nasemkhakheni wabatshuzi abakhokhelwayo abasebenza ngaphansi kolwandle kanye nowezolimo.

src: Protšeke ye e dirwa ka tirišano le setheo sa Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute le Sekhwama sa Inšorentshe ya go Lahlegelwa ke Mešomo (UIF), e lego sehlongwa sa Kgoro ya Bašomi.
tgt: Lo mklamo uqhutshwa ngokubambisana ne-Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute kanye neSikhwama Somshwalense Wabantu Abaphelelwe Ngumsebenzi (i-UIF), okuyisikhungo soMnyango Wezabasebenzi.

src: Protšeke ye e tla lebelela kudu batho bao ba bego ba lefela sekhwana sa UIF bao ba lahlegetšwego ke mešomo.
tgt: Lo mklamo uzogxila kulabo asebephelelwe ngumsebenzi ababengamalungu e-UIIqembu lokuqala labantu abazohlomula libandakanya amalungu e-UIF angama-50 avela esikhumulweni sezindiza saseThekwini, i-Virginia Airport abangama-50 abavela emklamweni ose-Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natali, wabatshuzi abakhokhelwayo abasebenza ngaphansi kolwandle, kanye nabesifazane abaphuma endaweni esemakhaya yaseMadungeni, abazoqeqeshwa ukuze basungule umfelandawonye ozotshala futhi ulime izithelo, imifino kanye nokotini, kubandakanya nokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezivuno zabo ukuze ilungele ukuthengiswa.

src: Sehlopha sa mathomo sa baholegi se akaretša balefi ba UIF ba 50 go tšwa ka Boemafofaneng bja Durban Virginia ba 50 go tšwa ka protšekeng ya go tipela ka meetseng a lewatle ka nepo ya go dira kgwebo ka Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, le basadi ba ka dinagamagaeng ba 100 go tšwa ka Emadungeni bao ba tlago hlwahlwa mabapi le go hloma kgwebo ya mohlakanelwa gore ba bjale le go lema dikenywa tša tlhago, merogo le khothone, go akaretšwa tshepedišo ya kabothekišo ya ditšweletšwa.
tgt: Le mifelandawonye seyisayine isivumelwano nenkampani yakwa-Pick n Pay, abazoyithengisela imifino, kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, ozothenga kubona indwangu yokwenza umfaniswano wesikole.

src: Dikgwebo tše tša mohlakanelwa di saenne tumelelano le Pick n Pay gore di abe merogo le Kgoro ya Tlhabollo ya Leago gore e hwetše ditlabelo tša go tšweletša yunifomo ya sekolo.
tgt: UMnyango Wezasekhaya IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwamahhovisi amasha oMnyango Wezasekhaya eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natali, okwenziwe nguMongameli Ramaphosa.

src: Go tliša ga ditirelo tša badudi fao go katološitšwego go ditšhaba tšeo di bego di beetšwe thoko go raloka tema ye bohlokwa go kgontšha le go maatlafatša temokrasi le toka ya setšhaba.
tgt: Ukwelulwa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni emiphakathini eyabe incishwe amathuba phambilini kudlala indima esemqoka kakhulu impela ekuqhubekiseni nasekujuliseni intando yeningi labantu kanye nobulungiswa emphakathini.

src: Se se bopa karolo ya boikgafo bja mmušo bja go tliša ditirelo kgauswi le batho.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuletheni izinsizakalo eduze kwabantu.

src: Lenaneo la go Hudugela go Bogaši bja Titšithale.
tgt: UHlelo Lokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetše ka ga kgatelopele ye e dirwago ya go hudušetša naga go tloga go kgašo ya manakana go ya go ya titšithale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligculisekile ngenqubekelaphambili eyenziwayo ekufudukeni kwezwe lisuka ekusakazeni nge-analogi liya kudijithali.

src: Bjalo ka karolo ya go balela go lebile Manthole ka 2018 go yo Tima Kgašo ya Manakana ka Foreisetata, theransemithara ya mathomo ka Senekal ka Foreisetata e tla tingwa ka la 20 Lewedi 2018.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokulungiselela ukufika kwenyanga kaZibandlela 2018, okuzocinywa ngayo i-analogi esifundazweni saseFreyistata, mhla zingama-20 kuMandulo 2018 kuzocinywa umbhobho wokusakaza wokuqala e-Senekal e-Freyistata.

src: Se ke go sepelelana le boikgafo bjo go dumelelanwego ka bjona le Mokgatlo wa Mananeokgoparara a Dikgokagano wa Boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambisana nesibophezelo okwavunyelwana ngaso neNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana (i-ITU).

src: Lesolo la dikgokagano le gare le a dirwa go netefatša gore malapa a lokile go amogela go tingwa mo.
tgt: Uyaqhubeka umkhankaso wokwazisa umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amakhaya asekulungele ukucinywa kwe-analogi.

src: Malapa ao a nago le dithelebišene tša manakana gomme a nyaka go reka dithelebišene tše diswa a eletšwa go kgetha tšeo di nago le tšhuna ya titšithale ka go tšona.
tgt: Lawo makhaya anomabonakude (i-TV) abasebenza nge-analogi anesifiso sokuthenga omabonakude abasha ayelulekwa ukuthi akhethe omabonakude anomshini owamukela isiginali yedijithali owakhelwe ngaphakathi kumabonakude.

src: Malapa ao a hwetšago letseno la ka godimo ga mollwane wa R3 200 ka kgwedi a na le kgetho ya go reka thelebišene ye e nago le titšhithale gomme e ageletšwe tekhoutara ya thelebišene ya therestriale ya titšithale, yeo e hwetšagalago ka mabenkeleng a magolo a go rekiša dithelebišene.
tgt: Lawo makhaya athola ingenisomali engaphezu komkhawulo obekiwe ongama-R3 200 ngenyanga, uma ethanda, angaqoka ukuzithengela umabonakude omusha onedikhoda eyakhelwe ngaphakathi eyamukela isiginali yedijithali, otholakala ezitolo ezinkulu ezithengisa impahla yasendlini.

src: Go fokotša bašomi mešomong.
tgt: Ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi.

src: Go latela boipiletšo bja Mopresidente Ramaphosa bja go fega go fokotša bašomi mešomong fao e lego ka mabaka a maemo a ekonomi ka mo nageng, Kabinete e bušeletša boipiletšo bja yona go bengmešomo bja gore go fokotša bašomi mešomong go swanetše go ba selo sa mafelelo seo se ka dirwago, le gore mekgwa ye mengwe ya boithomelo ye e hwetšagalago ya go thibela ditshenyegelo e swanetše go dirišwa go dira gore mešomo e be gona go ya go ile.
tgt: Ngenhloso sokusabela ekhweleni elishaywe nguMongameli Ramaphosa lokumiswa kwezinhlelo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi ngenxa yesimo somnotho esibhekene naleli lizwe, iKhabhinethi liyabanxusa abaqashi ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi kuyinto abayenza kuphela uma sekuhluleke wonke amakhambi atholakalayo, futhi kumele kuzanywe ikakhulukazi eminye imizamo yezindlela zesimanjemanje ezikhona zokunciphisa izindleko ukuze kuvikelwe imisebenzi.

src: Dipalopalo ka ga bosenyi.
tgt: Izibalomanani zobugebengu.

src: Kabinete e thekga tsenogare ye e dirilwego ke Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Tšhireletšo ya go rerišana ka ga leanokakaretšo la go šogana le mathata ao a fapafapanego ao a tšweletšego ka go dipalopalo tšeo di sa tšwago go lokollwa tša mabapi le bosenyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo lweQoqo Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka lokungenelela ngokuthi kuqaliswe ngokushesha iqhingasu elibanzi lokubhekana nezinkinga ezihlukahlukene ezivezwe yizibalomanani zobugebengu ezikhishwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule.

src: Se se akaretša Seboka sa Bosetšhaba ka ga Bosenyi le Thibelo ya Dikgaruru seo se sa tšwago go swarwa ka fase ga morero wa, “Re aga ditšhaba tše di bolokegilego ka go diriša mokgwa wa tlhabollo wo o kopantšwego wa go thibela bosenyi le dikgaruru”, seo se hlomilego nepo ya mohlakanelwa ka ga polokego bjalo ka maikarabelo a bohle, le go fana ka sefala go bakgathatema le ditsebi tše bohlokwa gore di rerišane ka ga tsenyotirišong ye e šomago gabotse ya Pampiri ya Ditherišano ya 2016 ka ga Polokego le Tšhireletšo go putlaganya mafapha ka moka.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya neNgqungquthela Kazwelonke Yokuvimbela Ubugebengu Nodlame ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi “Sakha imiphakathi ephephile ngokusebenzisa indlela edidiyelwe futhi ethuthukisayo yokuvimbela ubugebengu nodlame”, okuyingqungquthela eyathuthukisa inhlosombono efanayo yokubheka udaba lokuphepha njengomsebenzi osemahlombe omuntu wonke, futhi eyahlinzeka ngesigcawu sokuthi ababambiqhaza kanye nongoti abasemqoka baxoxisane ngokuqaliswa kahle kuyo yonke imikhakha koMthetho Odingidwayo wezi-2016 Ophathelene Nokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Ditiragalo tša dikgaruru Kabinete e tshwenywa kudu ke maemo a dikgaruru ka setšhabeng sa rena gomme e ipiletša go mafapha ka moka, go ditšhaba le go ditheo tša phethagatšo ya molao go šoma mmogo go netefatša gore dikolo le mafelo a setšhaba a bolokegile le go šireletšega.
tgt: Izigameko zodlame IKhabhinethi likhathazeke kakhulu ngokuphakama kwezinga lodlame kuleli futhi linxusa yonke imikhakha, imiphakathi kanye nezikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuba basebenzisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole kanye nezindawo zomphakathi ziphephile futhi zivikelekile.

src: Ditiragalo tša dikgaruru tše di hlagilego ka dikarolong tše mmalwa tša naga ga di amogelege ebile di kgahlanong le Molaotheo wa rena.
tgt: Azamukelekile nakancane izenzo zodlame eziqubuke ezingxenyeni eziningana zakuleli futhi lokhu kuphambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe.

src: Kabinete e reta Tirelo ya Maphodisa ya Afrika Borwa (SAPS) ka ga diphetolo tša yona tša ka pela ge ba golegile bao go gononelwago gore ba kgathile tema ka dikgarurung tša setšhaba le go ba le dithoto tšeo di gononelwago gore di utsitšwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawuncoma impela uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ekubopheni labo okusolakala ukuthi bayabandakanyeka ezigamekweni zodlame lomphakathi kanye nalabo abatholakale nezimpahla okusolakala sengathi zintshontshiwe.

src: Leuba la Klebsiella Kabinete e lebiša mahloko go ba malapa a masea a tshela ao a hlokofetšego ka morago ga go tšwelela ga leuba la Klebsiella pneumoniae ka Sepetleleng sa Thelle Mogoerane ka Vosloorus.
tgt: Ukubheduka kobhubhane lwesifo se-Klebsiella IKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yabantwana abayisithupha abashonile kulandela ukubheduka kwesifo se-Klebsiella pneumoniae esibhedlela i-Thelle Mogoerane Hospital e-Vosloorus.

src: Leuba le ga bjale le ka fase ga taolo.
tgt: Njengamanje selunqandiwe lolu bhubhane.

src: Tona ya Maphelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, o ile a tsebagatša gore masea le bommagobona ka sepetleleng se a tla fetišetšwa ka Sepetleleng sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela le ka sepetleleng sa Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, usememezele ukuthi abantwana nomama babo bazothunyelwa esibhedlela i-Nelson Mandela Children’s Hospital kanye ne-Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.

src: Se se fa kgoro ya maphelo ya ka profenseng ye sebaka sa go gohla mabato le go tloša tšhilafatšo ka bolwetši bjo tikologong yeo, le gape go rarolla mathata a peakanyo, ka ntle le tšhitišo.
tgt: Lokhu kuzonikeza umnyango wezempilo wesifundazwe ithuba lokukhuculula nokususa igciwane lalesi sifo esibhedlela, futhi kulungiswe izinkinga eziphathelene nokuqhutshwa komsebenzi kulesi sibhedlela ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.

src: Diphetho.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKabhinethi.

src: Maano a go hlohleletša ekonomiKabinete e rerišane le go dumelela ditšhišinyo tša maano a go hlohleletša ekonomi tšeo di šišinyago magato a go goketša leswa ekonomi ya rena go tšwa go makala a mmalwa ao a amanago.
tgt: Iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnothoIKhabhinethi lifakane imilomo, laphinde lagunyaza iphakheji yezinyathelo zokuvuselela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, ephakamisa ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuvuselela kabusha umnotho wezwe ngokugxila emikhakheni ethile ehlobene.

src: Tshedimošo go ba kgašo ye e tlago etwa pele ke Mopresidente Ramaphosa e tla swarwa ka Labohlano la 21 Lewedi go hlagiša maano a. Dipeakanyoleswa tša go amana le VISAKabinete e amogetše gape pego ya mohlakanelwa go tšwa go Ditona tša Merero ya Selegae le Boeti, ka ga dipeakanyoleswa tše mmalwa tša go amana le visa tšeo di tlago dira gore go be bonolo go baeti, go beng ba dikgwebo le go dirutegi go tla ka Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Kuzobanjwa isithangami sabezindaba esizoholwa nguMongameli Ramaphosa mhla zingama-21 kuMandulo lapho kuzokwethulwa khona le phakeji.

src: Dipeakanyoleswa tše di akaretša diphetošo go melaotshepetšo ye e dirišwago go bana ba badudi ba dinaga tša ka ntle bao ba etelago ka Afrika Borwa, tšeo di tlago tsenywa ka gare ga kuranta ya mmušo ka Diphalane.
tgt: Izinguquko eziphathelene nama-VISAIKhabhinethi lithole futhi nombiko owethulwe ngokuhlanganyela nguNgqongqoshe Wezasekhaya kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuvakasha, mayelana nezinguquko eziphathelene nezimvume zokungena kwabantu bakwamanye amazwe kuleli, ama-visa, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuza eNingizimu Afrika kwezivakashi, osomabhizinisi kanye nezifundiswa.

src: Ditherišano ka ga go fedišwa ga di-visa le go nyefiša melawana ya dinyakwa tša tšona go dinaga tše itšego le tšona di sa phethwa.
tgt: Lezi zinguquko zibandakanya ukuchitshiyelwa kwemithethonqubo eqondene nezingane zakwamanye amazwe ezingena eNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kuzoshicilelwa kusomqulu kahulumeni ngoMfumfu.

src: Dintlha ka botlalo mabapi le se di tla tsebagatšwa mo bekeng ye.
tgt: Eminye imininingwane mayelana nalokhu izomenyezelwa kuleli viki.

src: Melaokakanywa.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše Melaokakanywa ye gore e phatlalatšwe gore setšhaba se fe ditshwaotshwao ka ga yona:.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likugunyazile ukushicilelwa kwale Mithethosivivinywa elandelayo ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo:.

src: Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Tekatekano Mešomong wa 2017.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezokulingana wezi-2017.

src: Diphetošo tše di nyaka go maatlafatša mekgwa ya go obamela melao ebile di tla dumelela gore go hlongwe dinepišo tša dipalopalo ka ga tekatekano ya go thwala bašomi mešomong go ya ka mafapha a itšego.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zihlose ukuqinisa izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho futhi zizovumela ukusungulwa kwemigomo nemikhawulo yezibalomanani zokuqasha ngokulingana okuhloswe ukufinyelela kuyona eziqondene ngqo nomkhakha ngamunye.

src: Tona ya Bašomi, ka go rerišana le bakgathatema ba ka mo lefapheng le, e tla kgona go hloma dinepišo tša dipalopalo ka ga tekatekano ya go thwala bašomi mešomong go ya ka mafapha a itšego.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi, ebambisene nababambiqhaza bemikhakha, uzokwazi ukubeka imigomo nemikhawulo yezibalomanani zokuqasha ngokulingana okumele kufinyelelwe kuyona eziqondene ngqo nomkhakha ngamunye.

src: Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Melao ya Lefapha la Ditšhelete wa 2018: Diphetošo tše di nyaka go maatlafatša ditlhagišo tša bolaodi bja tshepedišo go dipanka, go akaretšwa le go dipanka tša ditlamo le tša kgwebo, le tše dingwe tšeo e sego dipanka.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wemithetho Yomkhakha Wezimali wezi-2018: Lezi zichibiyelo zihlose ukuqinisa izimiselo zobufukamelimafa (i-curatorship) bamabhange, kubandakanya amabhange amakhasimende (ama-mutual bank) kanye namabhange ayimifelandawonye (ama-cooperative bank), kanjalo nezinye izikhungo zezimali ezingagunyaziwe ukusebenza njengebhange.

src: Diphetošo tše di tla netefatša gore ge dihlongwa tše tša ditšhelete di ka itemogela mathata, di ka thušwa ka mokgwa wo o šireletšago bao ba tepositilego ditšhelete gomme ba le kotsing ebile go na le ditšhitišo tše nnyane go tshepedišo ya ditšhelete le ka ekonoming ka kakaretšo.
tgt: Lezi zinguquko zizoqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zezimali ezihlangabezana nobunzima, zithola ukulekelelwa ngendlela ezovikela abafakimali abasengcupheni futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphazamiseki kakhulu izinhlelo zezimali kanye nomnotho wonkana.

src: Ditiragalo tše di tlago.
tgt: Imicimbi Ezayo.

src: Mokete wa Letšatši la Bosetšhaba la Bohwa la 2018 ka fase ga morero wa: “Ngwaga wa Nelson Mandela: Re tšwetšapele diphetogo tša sebopego sa bohwa bja Afrika Borwa”, o tlo swarwa ka Lepatlelong la Riverview ka Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Usuku Lwamagugu Imigubho yoSuku Lwamagugu Lukazwelonke lowezi-2018 ezoqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Unyaka ka-Nelson Mandela: Siqhubekisela phambili uguquko kwezamagugu eNingizimu Afrika”, izobanjelwa eNkundleni yase-Riverview e-Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Se ke karolo ya lenaneo la kgwedi ka moka la ditiragalo tšeo di rarollago merero ya diphetogo, tšwetšopele le go lota bohwa bja Afrika Borwa bjo bo humilego le bjo bo farologanego, boitšhupo bja setšhaba, kago ya setšhaba le tirišano ya setšhaba.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lwenyanga yonke lwemibungazo okuhloswe ngayo ukubhekana nezindaba eziphathelene noguquko, ukugqugquzelwa nokulondolozwa kwamagugu acebile futhi ahlukahlukene akuleli, ubuzwe, ukwakhiwa kwesizwe kanye nobumbano lomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mokete wo wa Letšatši la Bohwa ke tlhompho go Adam Kok le go ditšhaba tša maGriqua ka ga kgotlelelo ya sona, boikgafo le go ba bogale ge se be se ganetšana le go thopiwa ke bokoloniale.
tgt: Umgubho woSuku Lwamagugu kuzohlonishwa ngawo u-Adam Kok kanye nesizwe samaHilikwa (ama-Griqua) ngenxa yesibindi, ukuzimisela kanye namandla amakhulukazi abawabonisa ngenkathi belwisana nokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.

src: Kabinete e ipiletša go setšhaba go keteka botee bja sona gomme se diutše se farologane ge re šoma mmogo go aga naga yeo go yona batho ba yona ka moka ba kgathalelanago le go hlomphana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi ugubhe ubunye bawo nakuba wakhiwe ngabantu abanemvelaphi ehlukahlukene, ngenkathi sisebenza ngokubambisana ekwakheni izwe lapho bonke abantu balo bebonisa ukunakekelana nokuhloniphana.

src: Kopanokgothekgothe ya Mokgatlo wa Dinagakopano (UNGA).
tgt: Ukhukhulelangoqo Womhlangano Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNGA).

src: Ka go tsenya letsogo go ngwagakgolo wa Mopresidente wa peleng Nelson Mandela, UNGA e tla re ka la 24 Lewedi 2018 ya swara kopano ya boitokišetšo ya maemo a godimo ka ga khutšo lefaseng ka bophara ye e bitšwago Seboka sa Khutšo sa Nelson Mandela, e le go hlompha mengwaga ye lekgolo ya matswalo a Madiba.
tgt: Njengophawu lokufaka isandla emigubhweni yeminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMongameli waphambilini u-Nelson Mandela, mhla zingama-24 kuMandulo 2018 i-UNGA izobamba umhlangano ozokwethanyelwa nayizicukuthwane okuzobhungwa kuwona ngodaba lokuthula emhlabeni, owaziwa ngeNgqungquthela ka-Nelson Mandela Yokuthula, ngenhloso yokubungaza ukuhlangana kweminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa uMadiba.

src: Kopano ye ya boitokišetšo e beakantšwe gore e tla amogela kwano ya sepolotiki ye e rerišanwego ke Dinagamaloko tša UNGSe se latela ditherišano tše di swerwego ke Baemedi ba sa ruri mokgatlong wa UN ba Afrika Borwa le Ireland, bao ba šomago bjalo ka basepedišimmogo, le mebušo ka ga diteng tša kwano yeo.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuthi lo mhlangano wamukele isivumelwano sezepolitiki okufinyelelwe kusona emva kwezingxoxo phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu e-UNGLokhu kulandela ukubonisana kohulumeni bezwekazi ezingxoxweni ebeziholwa ngokubambisana nguMmeleli weNingizimu Afrika Osebenza Ngokugcwele KwiNhlangano Yezizwe kanye nozakwabo wase-Ireland, mayelana nalokho okuqukethwe esivumelwaneni.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa go emetšwe gape gore o tla kgatha tema ka Kopanong ya Maemo a Godimo ya UN ka ga bolwetši bja mafahla (TB) ka la 26 Lewedi 2018.
tgt: Kulindeleke futhi ukuthi uMongameli Ramaphosa abambe iqhaza emhlanganweni weNhlangano Yezizwe ozokwethanyelwa nayizicukuthwane okuzobhungwa kuwona ngesifo sofuba (i-TB), mhla zingama-26 kuMandulo 2018.

src: TB ke bolwetši bjo bogolo ka Afrika gomme tše dingwe tša dinaga tše di rwelego morwalo wa godimo ka TB di ka mo khonthinenteng.
tgt: I-TB yisifo esiyinkinga enkulu e-Afrika futhi amanye alawo mazwe omhlaba anesibalo esiphakeme kakhulu sabantu abatheleleke nge-TB atholakala kulona leli lizwekazi.

src: Melaetša.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: MahlokoKabinete e romela mahloko a yona go ba malapa ao a lobilego bao ba ba ratago ka kotsing ya pese ye e hlagilego tseleng ya N1-25 kgauswi le Tobias ka Masepaleng wa Selete wa Waterberg ka Limpopo.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzoIKhabhinethi lidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe yizihlobo zayo engozini yebhasi eyenzeke emgwaqeni onguthelawayeka u-N1-25 eduze kwase-Tobias kuMasipala Wesifunda i-Waterberg eLimpopo.

src: Kabinete e lakaletša bao ba gobetšego gore ba fole ka pela.
tgt: Futhi iKhabhinethi libafisela ukwelulama okusheshayo bonke abalimele.

src: DitebogišoKabinete e lebogiša Tona ya Tlhabollo ya Dikgwebopotlana, Mohumagadi Lindiwe Zulu, ge a amogetšwe maemong a godimo a Sefoka sa Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), le ka go Grand Cross go tšwa Mmušong wa Brazil.
tgt: Amazwi okuhalaliselaIKhabhinethi lihalalisela uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhinisi Amancane, uNkz Lindiwe Zulu, ohlonishwe nguhulumeni wase-Brazil ngendondo esesigabeni esiphezulu kakhulu i-Order of Rio Branco (i-Ordem de Rio Branco), kanye ne-Grand Cross nguhulumeni wase-Brazil.

src: Se ke go lemoga maitapišo ao a tšwelago pele a Tona a go maatlafatša dikamano gareng ga Brazil le Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuwukuhlonishwa kukaNgqongqoshe ngemizamo yakhe, elokhu iqhubeke njalo, yokwenza ngcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Brazil neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sefoka se sa tlhompho sa ka Brazil se fiwa bao ba itšhupilego ka ditirong tša tirelo ya bokgoni bjo bogolo le ka go tšwetše peleng ga maitshwaro a mabotse ka setšhabeng.
tgt: Le ndondo yase-Brazil inikezwa labo abazibonakalisile ngemisebenzi yabo encomekayo futhi abagqame nangezenzo zabo ezinhle kakhulu zokusebenzela umphakathi.

src: Tona Zulu e bile Motseta wa Afrika Borwa ka Brazil gareng ga 2004 le 2008.Bao ba thwetšwego mešomongBatho ka moka bao ba thwetšwego mešomong mangwalo a bona a dithuto a tla tiišetšwa le go netefaletšwa ka maleba.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe uZulu wayeyinxusa leNingizimu Afrika kwelase-Brazil phakathi kowezi-2004 nowezi-2008.AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la 10 Diphalane 2018 ka Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangano walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-10 kuMfumfu 2018 e-Tuynhuys eKapa.

src: Kabinete e amogela magatotharollo a go swana le boikgafo bja go reka ditšweletša tša ka mo nageng, lemanoga leo le tieletšego la go hlatloša diyantle, ditharollo tše dirišwago magatong a kgwebo ya tša temo le go thekgwa ga dikgwebopotlana le dikgwebo tša magareng.
tgt: Umnotho kanye nomkhankaso wotshalomali.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokungenelela eziphathekayo futhi ezinohlonze ezinjengokuzibophezela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo yakuleli, ukuqiniswa kakhudlwana kwemizamo yokukhulisa umthamo wempahla yakuleli ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle, izinhlelo zokungenelela ochungechungeni lomsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo kanye nokweseka amabhizinisi asafufusa.

src: Ditsebišo tše di tšwa Samiting ya Mešomo ya matšatši a mabedi malobanyana mo, ye bego e e swerwe ka fase ga Khansele ya Tlhabollo ya Ikonomi ya Bosetšhaba le Bašomi.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwumphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ethathe izinsuku ezimbili ebibanjwe esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebibizwe ngaphansi koMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye Nezabasebenzi (i-Nedlac).2 Umphumela weNgqungquthela Yemisebenzi ulandela isimemezelo soHlelo Lokuvuselela Nokugqugquzela Ukusimama Komnotho, oluhlose ukubuyisa nokuvuselela ukukhula komnotho futhi ludale namathuba omsebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: Ditlamorago tša Samiti ya Bašomi di latela go tsebagatšwa Maano a Hlohleletšo le go Tsošwa ga Ikonomi, ao a nepilego go bušetša sekeng kgolo ya ikonomi le go hlola mešomo ye nyakegago kudu.
tgt: Usomqulu Wezimayini omusha – ophothulwe ngokubonisana nemboni yezimayini, abasebenzi, imiphakathi ethintekile kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza – icacisa izinto ezisemqoka kakhulu okumele zenziwe ukuze kulethwe ukukhula komnotho, ukusimama kanye noguquko.3 IKhabhinethi liyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuthi bawucubungule futhi bazame ukuwuqonda uSomqulu Wezimayini ukuze uphothulwe futhi kulethwe uzinzo emkhakheni wezimayini.

src: Tšhatha ye Mpsha ya Meepo yeo e kwanetšwego le go rungwa ka therišano le intasteri ya meepo, bašomi, batho bao ba amegago setšhabeng le bakgathatema ba bangwe e hlatholla ditlamego tša kgolo ya ikonomi, go swarelela ga yona le diphetogo ikonoming.
tgt: Ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya lase-Kokstad kanye nokunikezwa kwamatayitela.1 NjengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, iKhabhinethi nalo liyawuncoma impela uMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokuvula ngempumelelo ihhovisi lawo lase-Kokstad KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Kabinete e dira boipiletšo go bakgathatema ka moka go tšea karolo mo Tšhatheng ya Meepo e le gona go ruma le go hlola tielelo lefapheng la meepo.
tgt: UMongameli wavula ngokusemthethweni leli hhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya njengengxenye yohlelo lukahulumeni lokwelula ukufinyelela kwezizinda zoMnyango Wezasekhaya ezihlinzeka ngezidingongqangi kubantu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesasasa elikhulu eliboniswa yizakhamuzi zakuleli komazisi bekhadi kanye nezinye izincwadi.2 Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMongameli Ramaphosa wadlulisela amatayitela angaphezu kwama-443 ezandleni zabahlomuli boMklamo Wezindlu wase-Franklin.

src: Mopresidente o butše kantoro ya Merero ya Selegae bjalo ka karolo ya lenaneo la mmušo la go oketša mafelo a kabo ya ditirelo a Merero ya Selegae go fihlelela dinyakwa tša badudi tša dikarata tša boitsebišo (di-Smart ID) le ditokumente tše dingwe.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo lokuvuselela ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlomuli bathokozela imihlomulo ephelele yokuba ngabanikazi bezindlu futhi ukuze bakwazi nokufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba ehlelekile.3 IKhabhinethi lithanda futhi ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukukhuthaza izakhamuzi zakuleli ukuthi zihambe ziyolanda omazisi bazo ngokushesha emva kokuthola isaziso esibanxusa ukuthi beze bazobalanda.

src: Go feta mo, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o fane ka dithaetleletiti tše 443 go bao ba holegago go tšwa Protšekeng ya Dintlo ya Franklin.
tgt: Ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni mayelana nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya IKhabhinethi liyasamukela isivumelwano okufinyelelwe kusona mayelana nodaba olubandakanya isiMemo Sokufakwa Kwezicelo eziqondene nokwabiwa kwamagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.

src: Ye ke karolo ya lenaneo la pušetšosekeng go netefatša gore baamogedi ba ditirelo tše ba itemogela mehola ye feletšego ya go ba beng ba ntlo le gore ba kgona go fihlelela mebaraka ye lego molong ya dithoto.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka ukuqiniseka mayelana nezinqubomgomo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana (i-ICT).

src: Kabinete e tšea gape sebaka se go hlohleletša badudi go ya go itšeela dipasa tša bona ka bjako morago ga go amogela taletšo ya go ya go di tšea.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sihambelana nekhwelo likaMongameli Ramaphosa lokuqaliswa kwenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalayisensi amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya afunwa kakhulu.3 Ngenhloso yokufaka isandla esithe xaxa ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlaka Lombiko Odingidwayo Wenqubomgomo Ye-ICT Edidiyelwe Kazwelonke, bonke abanentshisekelo bazonikezwa ithuba lokuhlinzeka uphiko ngemibono yabo ebhalwe phansi kuze kube ngumhla ziyisi-8 kuLwezi 2018 mayelana nenqubomgomo ehlongozwayo kanye nesiqondiso senqubomgomo.

src: Kwano ya go lefa ka botlalo ya diamogedi tša maphoto a diyalemoya.
tgt: Imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi liyayamukela imifelandawonye yabadobi abancane yokuqala ngqa yaseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokudoba, okungumfelandawonye wase-Port Nolloth kanye nowase-Hondeklipbaai eNyakatho Kapa, eyathulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezokudoba, uMnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Kabinete e amogela kwano ya go lefa ka botlalo yeo e fihleletšwego mo tabeng ya go amana le Taletšo ya go Dira dikgopelo tša diamogedi maphoto a diyalemoya tšeo di nyakegago kudu.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwale mifelandawonye kuwuphawu lokuqaliswa kokusebenza kwenqubomgomo yabadobi abancane.

src: Kwano ye e fana ka boitshepho mererong ya dipholisi mo lefapheng la theknolotši ya tshedimošo le ya dikgokagano (ICT).
tgt: Amalungelo okudoba anikeza abadobi bendawo isithunzi, njengoba bebedoba ngokungemthetho, kepha-ke manje sebevikelekile, futhi kungokokuqala ngqa ukuthi kwenzeke into enjalo kuleli.

src: Kwano ye ya go lefa ka botlalo e tsamaišana le boipiletšo bja Mopresidente Ramaphosa bja go thomiša ka tshepedišo ya go aba abaganya laesense ya maphoto a radio ao a nyakegago kudu.
tgt: Le miphakathi yabadobi abancane emibili ezohlomula kule nqubomgomo seyithole ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo mayelana nemifelandawonye futhi ilekeleliwe ukubhalisa imifelandawonye yayo ukuze ikwazi ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-.

src: Ka gona go kgatha tema go ya pele mo phethagatšong ya Sengwalwa sa Makgoraditsela ya Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya ICT ya Mohlakanelwa, bakgathatema bao ba nago le kgahlego ba filwe go fihla ka la 8 Dibatsela go fana ka dikgopolo tše ngwadilwego fase mo pholising ye šišintšwego le tlhahlo ya pholisi go balaodi.
tgt: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela.1 IKhabhinethi liyabancoma abakhokhi bentela ababalelwa ezigidini ezintathu asebewathumelile amafomu abo entela, futhi abayisigamu kulaba bawathumele nge-inthanethi amafomu abo besebenzisa uhlelo lwe-eFiling.

src: A Dikgwebo tše nnyane tša mathomothomo tša Afrika Borwa tša boreatlhapi Kabinete e amogela ka atla tše pedi dikgwebo tše nnyane tša mathomothomo tša boreatlhapi mo lefapheng la boreatlhapi ebago dikgwebo tša Port Nolloth le Hondeklipbaai gola Kapa Leboa, tšeo di tsebagaditšwego ke Tona ya Temo, Kagodithokgwa le Boreatlhapi, Morena Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Mhla zingama-31 kuMfumfu, siyavalwa isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela sowezi-2018 maqondana nabakhokhi bentela abathola ingenisomali evela emholweni kuphela kanye nabakhokhi bentela yesithutshana (okusho labo abathola ingenisomali ngale komholo, noma ingenisomali evela ebhizinisini) abaqoka ukuzihambisela amafomu abo mathupha egatsheni lesiKhungo Esiqoqa Intela saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Ditokelo tša go rea ditlhapi di fa barei ba ditlhapi ba lefelo le seriti, bao ba bego ba rea ditlhapi ka tsela ye sego molaong ka gobane ka wo motsotso ba šireleditšwe lekga la mathomothomo.
tgt: Abakhokhi bentela yesithutshana abaqoka ukuthumela amafomu nge-eFiling bazonikezwa ithuba lokuthumela amafomu abo kuze kube ngumhla zingama-31 kuMasingana 20.2 Ukuqoqwa ngendlela efanele kwemali engenayo emgodlagodleni kahulumeni kuqinisekisa amandla aleli lizwe olulawula imali engenayo ngokuzimela futhi ukuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela aqukethe imininingwane efanelekile, ngesikhathi esibekiwe, kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi abakhokhi bentela bathathwa njengabantu abawuthobelayo umthetho wezentela.

src: Metsana ye mebedi ya dikgwebo tše nnyane tša boreatlhapi yeo e tla bego e holega go tšwa mo pholising ye e amogetše tlhahlo ya motheo go tša kgwebo ebile e thušitšwe go ngwadiša dikgwebo ka maikemišetšo a go dira kgopelo ya maloka a mengwaga ye lesome tlhano a go rea ditlhapi.
tgt: Imali etholakala ngokukhokhwa kwentela ilekelela uhulumeni ukuze akwazi ukuxhasa ngezimali imiklamo yokuthunyelwa kwezidingongqangi kuleli kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalomnotho.

src: Kabinete e lebogiša balefi ba motšhelo ba go balelwa dimilione tše tharo bao ba rometšego bohlatse bja ditefo tša bona tša metšhelo bao seripa sa bona ba rometšego bohlatse bja metšhelo ya bona ka eFiling.
tgt: Ukukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni.1 IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko yiKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene: Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Nodaba Lwezibonelelomali Zikahulumeni, usihlalo walo okunguNgqongqoshe Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Ka la 31 Diphalane, sehla sa metšhelo sa 2018 se fihla mafelelong go balefi ba motšhelo ba e sego ba lebakanyana le balefi ba motšhelo ba lebakanyana bao ba ikgethetšego go romela bohlatse bja ditefo tša bona tša metšhelo lekaleng la Ditirelo tša Afrika Borwa tša Lekgetho (SARS).
tgt: Kusukela mhla lu-1 kuMfumfu 2018, bangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 abahlomuli abakhokhelwe izibonelelomali zabo kusetshenziswa ezinye zalezi zikhungo ezilandelayo – iPosi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye nezitolo ezinjengo-Boxer, Shoprite, kanye no-Pick n Pay.2 Uhulumeni usekwazile ukufudukisa ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokukhokhwa kwezibonelelomali zikahulumeni usuka enkampanini yakwa-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) ngokomyalelo wesiNqumo Senkantolo.

src: Balefi ba metšhelo ba lebakanyana bao ba ikgethelago go romela bohlatse bja bona bja tefo ya metšhelo ka eFilling ba filwe go fihla ka la 31 Pherekgong 2019 go ka romela.
tgt: Bonke abahlomuli abebekhokhelwa imali engukheshi ngu-CPS sebefudukisiwe futhi i-CPS seyazisiwe ngokuqedwa kwenkontileka yayo kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 20.3 IKhabhinethi lidlulisa ukubonga kwalo ngomsebenzi wokuqapha omuhle kakhulu obuholwa yiThimba LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene lisekelwa yiThimba Elikhethekile LabaQondisi Jikelele Abanolwazi Olunzulu Emsebenzini Walo Mkhakha.

src: Kgoboketšo ye maleba le ya go dirwa ka nako ya metšhelo e netefatša go ikema ka noši matlotlong a mmušo, le gona dithomelo tša bohlatse bjo nepagetšego bja metšhelo bo netefatša balefi ba metšhelo ba go latela molao.
tgt: Liyawubonga futhi umsebenzi omuhle wezikhulu ezivela ku-SAPO, Inhlangano Yezimpesheni Nezibonelelo Zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa) kanye noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi OwezeNgqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi OwezokuHlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Owezezimali Kuzwelonke uMbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye Nophiko Lukahulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokuhlinzeka Ngolwazi (i-GCIS).4 IKhabhinethi liyababonga bonke abahlomuli bezibonelelomali zikahulumeni ngobambiswano lwabo abalubonisile kulesi sikhathi soguquko.

src: Letseno la metšhelo le thuša mmušo go thekga diprotšeke tša naga ye tša kabo ya ditirelo ka ditšhelete le mananeo a mangwe a tlhabollo ya ikonomi maphelong a batho.
tgt: Imigubho yekhulu-nyaka lika-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi lethulelwe umbiko mayelana namalungiselelo omgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu ozobanjwa ngenyanga azalwa ngayo, uMfumfu.

src: Kabinete e sedimošitšwe ke Komiti ya Magareng ga Ditona: Dithušo tša Tšhelete tša Leago yeo modulasetulo wa yona e lego Tona Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: UMama uSisulu wazalwa mhla zingama-21 kuMfumfu 1918, futhi usiHlalo WeKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene Ejutshwe Umsebenzi Wokuhlela Lo mgubho, uNgqongqoshe u-Jeff Radebe, ukhona lapha ukuzochaza kabanzi mayelana nemicimbi nemisebenzi ezokwenziwa ephathelene nomgubho wekhulu-nyaka likaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Ga e sale go tloga ka la 1 Diphalane 2018, baamogedi ba go feta dimilione tše lesome ba lefilwe ka go šomiša o mongwe wa mekgwa ye ya go lefa – Poskantoro ya Afrika Borwa (SAPO)/Postbank Grindrod Bank le dikgwebo tše bjalo ka Boxer, Shoprite, le Pick n Pay.
tgt: Ukugwetshwa kukababa wase-Springs.1 IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukugwetshwa kwendoda enesihluku, edume ngeleNunu Esabekayo yase-Springs (i-Springs Monster).

src: Kabinete e lebiša ditebogo tša yona mošomong wa mafolofolo wa phetleko wo o eteletšwego pele ke Komiti ya Magareng ga Ditona ya go thekgwa ke Sehlophatšhomo sa Sethekniki sa Balaodipharephare.
tgt: Udlame oluqondiswe kwabesifazane lusalokhu luyinselele enkulu ezweni lethu, njengoba lokhu kubonakale ngokucacile esigamekweni sokudlwengulwa kwengane esencane esenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule esitolo sokudla sakwa-Dros e-Silverton.

src: Kabinete e thabela gape mošomo wa bahlankedi ba go tšwa SAPO, Etšensi ya Tšhireletšego ya Leago ya Afrika Borwa (Sassa) le dikgoro tše: Tlhabollo ya Leago Mananeokgoparara a Dikgokagano le Ditirelo tša Poso Peakanyo, Tekodišišo le Tshekatsheko ya Phethagatšo ya Mošomo, Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba Tirelo ya Maphodisa a Afrika Borwa (SAPS) le Tshepetšo ya Dikgokagano le Tshedimošo ya Mmušo (GCIS).
tgt: Khabhinethi liyagcizelela ekhweleni eliqondiswe kwiziphathimandla eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ukuthi zenze konke okusemandleni azo ukushushisa abenzi balawa macala amabi kangaka.

src: Kabinete e leboga baamogedi ka moka ba dithušo tša tšhelete tša leago ka tšhomišanommogo ya bona nakong ye ya diphetogo.
tgt: Futhi liyasinxusa sonke ukuthi sisebenzisane ekunqandeni ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ezingane nalawo malungu omphakathi angakwazi ukuzivikela futhi adinga ukubhekelelwa kakhudlwana.

src: Meketeko ya mengwaga ye lekgolo ya Albertina Sisulu Kabinete e sedimošitšwe ka ditokišetšo tša meketeko ya mengwaga ye lekgolo ya Mama Albertina Sisulu tšeo di tla kgatlampanago ka kgwedi ya gagwe ya matswalo ebago Diphalane.
tgt: Imibhikisho yase-Westbury.1 IKhabhinethi liyazamukela izinyathelo zokungenelela e-Westbury ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe uBheki Cele, eziyingxenye yeqhingasu elibanzi lokulwisana nesihlava sezidakamizwa kanye nodlame oluphathelene nemigulukudu kuleya ndawo.2 Izinyathelo zokungenelela zibandakanya ukutshalwa kwethimba lamaphoyisa akhethekile aqeqeshwe ngokujulile, adume “ngelamaBherethi”, kanye nokukhuliswa kwesibalo samaphoyisa aqaphile, ehla enyuka emphakathini, eqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi.

src: Mama Sisulu o belegwe ka la 21 Diphalane 1918 ebile Modulasetulo wa IMC Meketekong ya Mengwaga ye lekgolo, Tona Jeff Radebe, o gona mo go tlo hlatholla ditiragalo tšeo di tlago tša go amana le meketeko ya mengwaga ye lekgolo.
tgt: Ubugebengu IKhabhinethi liyazincoma impela izimpiko eziqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngophenyo olunzulu olumkhakha-mningi ezilwenzile oluphathelene nezigameko zeziqhumane ezitholakale ezikhungweni ezinenxanxathela yezitolo, ezitolo ezinkulu ezidumile kanye nasezindlini zesonto lamaSulumane (ama-mosque), okuwuphenyo oseluholele ekuboshweni kwabasolwa abayi-19.

src: Go ahlolwa ga papago ngwana wa kua Springs Kabinete e amogela go ahlolwa ga monna wa go tlaiša bana ba gagwe, yo a feleditšego a filwe leina la gore ke Lekgema la Springs.
tgt: Lolu phenyo belubandakanya neQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka.

src: O ahloletšwe mengwaga ye 35 kgolegong ka maitekelo a polao ya morwa wa gagwe, tlaišo ya bana le go se ba hlokomele, gotee le go šomiša gape le go gweba ka diokobatši.
tgt: Abasolwa abathathu kulaba baboshelwe amacala aphathelene neziqhumane ezatholakala ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene eThekwini, kubandakanya nendlu yesonto lamaSulumane e-Verulam.

src: Dikgaruru tša bong di santše e le tlhobaboroko ye šoro setšhabeng sa gaborena, ke ka lebaka leo re bonego dipego tša go katwa ga ngwana yo monyenyane malobanyana mo kua resturenteng ya Dros go la Silverton.
tgt: Bonke abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi babekwe amacala, kubandakanya elokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala kanye nokwephula uMthetho Weziqhumane.2 IKhabhinethi liyabaqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukulwisana nobugebengu kuyinto ebekwe eqhulwini futhi uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika baphila ngaphansi kwesimo esiphephile futhi esivikelekile.

src: Kabinete e gatelela boipiletšo bja yona go makgotla a phethagatšo ya molao go dira botšohle bja ona go sekiša babonwamolato ba bosenyi bjo bja go šiiša namana tša mmele.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa kwegama lendawo: Makhanda IKhabhinethi liyakwamukela ukuguqulwa kwegama ledolobha i-Grahamstown, eMpumalanga Kapa, libizwe ngeMakhanda, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umphrofethi, isazi senzululwazi kanye nomkhuzi wempi owalwisana nenqubo yokuqonelwa ngabezizwe.2 Lolu guquko luyingxenye esemqoka ohambweni lwentando yeningi labantu futhi luzolekelela ukuqinisa ubumbano lomphakathi futhi luzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakuleli bawuqonde futhi bawazise kakhudlwana umlando waleli lizwe, okungumlando wethu sonke.

src: Kabinete e amogela magatotharollo a kua Westbury ka Tona ya Maphodisa Bheki Cele ao e lego karolo ya leano le nabilego la go lwantšha lemena la diokobatši le dikgaruru tša go amana le dihlopha tša bosenyi mo lefelong le.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi lilugunyazile uhlelo olubuyekeziwe lokuqaliswa koMklamo Wokufudukela Ekusakazeni Ngedijithali.

src: Magatotharollo a a akaretša go thwalwa ga Sehlophatšhomo sa Mathadinthakwe (TRT - Maberethe) le ponagalo ye kgolo ya go ba gona ga maphodisa.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa indlela yokusebenza eqhutshwa yizimakethe noma izitolo ngokuthi kubanjiswane nomkhakha ozimele kanye nezimboni.

src: Se sengwe se bohlokwa ke gore go tla ba gape le dinyakišišo ditatofatšong tša bofora Seteišeneng sa Maphodisa sa Westbury.
tgt: Ngale ndlela yokusebenza, uhulumeni ngeke esazibandakanya ekuthengweni kwamabhokisana okudonsa isiginali kamabonakude (ama-set-top-boxes), ukugcinwa kwawo, kanye nokuthuthwa nokuxhunywa kwawo emakhaya.

src: Kabinete e dira boipiletšo setšhabeng sa Westbury le setšhabeng ka moka go šomišana le maphodisa go netefatša gore re epolla ka medu ditiragalo tša bosenyi, diokobatši le dihlopha tša bosenyi mafelong a bona a go fapafapana.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokuqhubekela phambili ekuphothulweni kwalo mklamo wokufudukela ekusakazeni ngedijithali ngendlela ebandakanyayo, engambi eqolo futhi esebenza kahle, futhi kunciphisa nobungozi kuhulumeni.

src: Bosenyi Kabinete e lebogiša makoko a phethagatšo ya molao ka go phethagatša dinyakišišo tšeo di tseneletšego tša mafelo ka moka tša go amana le dimolo tša mabenkele, mabenkele a kgwebo le dimoske tšeo pheletšo ya tšona e bilego go golegwa ga babelaelwa ba Tšona di be di amana le Seboka sa Toka, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Tšhireletšego.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhuphula inani lababukeli asebebukela umabonakude othola isiginali yedijithali lifinyelele emkhawulweni obekuhloswe ukufinyelela kuwona wama-85% futhi kuze kudlulele nangaphezulu kwalokho, njengoba kuphokophelwe ekucimeni wonke amasiginali okusakaza nge-analogi.

src: Kabinete e netefaletša maAfrika Borwa ka moka gore go lwantšha bosenyi ke taba ye tlago pele ga tšohle le gore mmušo o tla tšwelapele go tšea magato a maleba go netefatša tikologo ye bolokegilego le ye šireletšegilego go badudi ka moka ba Afrika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liwugunyazile uMbhalo Wemigomo Engumongo (i-Common Core Document) yeNingizimu Afrika, ozothunyelwa kwiNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN).

src: Go fetošwa ga leina: Makhanda Kabinete e amogela go fetošwa ga leina la Grahamstown gola Kapa Bodikela go ba Makhanda ka tlhompho ya moporofeta wa moXhosa, mofilosofi le monna wa sešole yo a lwantšhanego le bokoloniale.
tgt: Lo mbhalo uhlinzeka ngenqubekelaphambili equkethe ulwazi olujwayelekile olungamaqiniso futhi olunezibalomanani mayelana nokuthobela kweNingizimu Afrika izibopho ezihambisana nezivumelwano ze-UN eziyisishiyagalolunye ezasayinwa.

src: Diphetogo tše ke karolo ye bohlokwa ya leeto la rena la temokrasi ebile di tla thuša go tliša moya wa phedišano ye nabilego setšhabeng le go hlola kgahlego ye tseneletšego ya histori ya rena ya mohlakanelwa.
tgt: Imicimbi EzayoIsitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS)UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali u-Tito Mboweni uzokwethula Isitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS) ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018, esizoveza izinguquko ezithile ezenziwe kwisabelomali sikazwelonke ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukusimama kwezimali.

src: Moakanyetšo wo o diriša lemanoga leo le ithekgilego ka mebaraka/dikgwebo ka tšhomišano le ka dikgwebišano le sektara ya praebete le intasteri.
tgt: Inyanga Yezokuthutha Uhlelo lwalo nyaka lweNyanga Yezokuthutha lugcizelela ukubaluleka kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha, enjengezithuthi zasolwandle, izindiza, izitimela kanye nezithuthi ezihamba emgwaqeni njengoba lokhu kuyizinto ezisemqoka ezizolekelela ekukhuliseni umnotho.

src: Ka lona lemanoga le, mmušo o ka se hlwe o amega mo dithekišetšanong tša mapokisana a ditšithale a dithelebišene, go dirwa ga dintlophahlo, thwalo ya mapokisana ka dinamelwa le go tsentšhetša malapa a maleba didirišwa tše.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyawunxusa umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi futhi uqalise ngenkuthalo ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha emgwaqeni, okuyinto okumele yenziwe unyaka wonke.

src: Se se fa Afrika Borwa kgatelopele mo phethagatšong ya protšeke ka mokgwa wa go akaretša makala ka moka, wa go rekega le go phethwa ka nako, le ka mokgwa wa go fokotša kotsi mmušong.
tgt: Masisebenziseni iNyanga Yezokuthutha ukugubha nokubuyisa isikompilo lokuthi abantu bagibelisane emotweni eyodwa uma beya emsebenzini esikhundleni sokuthi umuntu ngamunye azihambele ngemoto yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe isiminyaminya sezimoto emigwaqeni yakuleli.

src: Se se tla rotoša babogedi ba tšhutišo ya ditšithale go fihla palong ya 85% le go feta, e le ge ba fetoša dikgašo ka moka tšeo e sego tša ditšithale.
tgt: Ukuphepha kusalokhu kuyinselele emgwaqeni yakuleli, futhi abashayeli kanye nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo kumele bayisebenzise ngokucophelela imigwaqo yomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše Sengwalwa sa Afrika Borwa sa Metheo ya Kobamelo seo se tla romelwago Ditšhabakopano (UN).
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuhalaliselaIsibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya, i-MeerKAT, sizoba yingxenye ye-Breakthrough Listen, okuwuhlelo lwamazwe ngamazwe lokucinga nokuthungatha izimpawu zezidalwa eziphilayo emkhathini.

src: Sengwalwa se se fana ka kgatelopele ye nago le tshedimošo ya mohuta wa kakaretšo, ya kgonthe le ya dipalopalo ya go latela ga Afrika Borwa ditlamegong tšeo di lego dikwanong tše senyane tšeo di saenetšwego tša UN.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ubuchwepheshe nengqalasizinda yakuleli ehlonishwa emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Tona ya Ditšhelete Tito Mboweni o tla fana ka Tlhahlo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetšokabo ya Paka ya Magareng (MTBPS) ka Laboraro, 24 Diphalane 2018, yeo e tla utollago peakanyolefsa ya tekanyetšokabo ya bosetšhaba go netefatša go swarelela ga matlotlo a mmušo.
tgt: I-MeerKAT, okuyisibonakude seNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngamagagasi omoya esinezindishi ezingama-64, esethulwa ngoNtulikazi kulo nyaka, yisibonakude esibukhali kunazo zonke izibonakude zohlobo olufanayo emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Kgwedi ya Dinamelwa Lenaneo la ngwaga wo la Kgwedi ya Dinamelwa le tla gatelela bohlokwa bja mananeokgoparara a dinamelwa tše bjalo ka mafapha a dikepe, difofane, ditimela le ditsela bjalo ka tšeo di kgontšhago go gola ga ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela ithimba labacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yase-Wits abenze ukufakelwa kwesibindi okuyingqophamlando futhi okube yimpumelelo, ngenkathi bethatha ingxenye yesibindi kumama Onegciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) beyifaka kumntwana wakhe ongenayo i-HIIthimba lodokotela belibandakanya uSlz Jean Botha, Dkt Francesca Conradie, Dkt Harriet Etheredge, Dkt June Fabian kanye noSlz Caroline Tiemessen.

src: Kabinete e dira boipiletšo setšhabeng go diriša dinamelwa tša bohle le go phethagatša maihlamelo a polokego ya mebileng ka mafolofolo go ralala ngwaga ka moka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela abantu base-Equatorial Guinea emgubhweni wama-50 wenkululeko yabo.

src: Anke re šomišeng kgwedi ye go keteka le go bušetša sekeng setlwaedi sa go nametšana difatanaga ge re eya mešomong go fokotša sephethephethe ditseleng tša rena.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Molewa wazibonakalisa ngomsebenzi wakhe omuhle ezikhundleni eziningi abethweswe zona kanye nasemikhankasweni yobushoshovu abeyishabashekela, kusukela kwigalelo lakhe emzabalwazweni wenkululeko yethu kuya kubushoshovu bakhe bokulwela amalungelo abesifazane alinganayo ezweni lethu.

src: Polokego ya ditseleng mo mebileng ya rena e santše e le tlhobaboroko, le gona baotledi le basepelakadinao ba swanetše go šomiša ditsela ka maikarabelo.
tgt: Futhi ubeyisishabasheki sikazwelonke nesomhlaba wonke jikelele ebesilwela ukuphathwa kahle kwemvelo ukuze sibe nomhlaba osimeme oyothokozelwa yibo bonke abantu futhi bahlalisane kahle kuwona.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la 24 Diphalane 2018 ka Tuynhuys, MotsekapaMerero ye bohlokwa seemong sa bjale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi labamba umhlangana walo ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-24 kuMfumfu 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Tlhahlo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetšokabo ya Paka ya Magareng (MTBPS).
tgt: Isitatimende Senqubomgomo Yesabelomali Sesikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Kabinete e amogela polelo ya mathomothomo ya MTBPS ka Tona ya Ditšhelete Tito Mboweni yeo e ikadilego ka kgopolo ye tieletšego ya gore Afrika Borwa e ka mpshafatšwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela i-MTBPS yokuqala kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uTito Mboweni, ebesisuselwa enkolelweni enkulu yokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa.

src: MTBPS ya 2018 e laetša dikgetho tše boima tša ikonomi le metšhelo tšeo di lebaganego le mmušo wa rena mo mengwageng ye meraro ye tlago.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 icaphuna ubunzima uhulumeni abhekene nabo ezinqumweni okumele azithathe kwezomnotho kanye nakwimali kahulumeni eminyakeni emithathu ezayo.

src: Kgolo ya ikonomi ngwageng wa 2018 e theogetše fase go tloga go 1.5% go fihla go 0.7%, le gona seemo sa ikonomi lefaseng ka bophara se santše se goga ka kgara mo mebarakeng ye tšwelelago ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ukukhula kwezomnotho konyaka wezi-2018 kubuyekeziwe kwasuka ku-1.5% kwaya ku-0.7%, futhi isimo somhlaba jikelele siqhubeka nokuba nezingqinamba kwezomnotho emazweni asafufusa.

src: MTBPS ya 2018 e kgontšha leano la Mopresidente la tlhabollo le go tsošwa ga ikonomi leo le thekgwago ke tielelo ya ikonomi le ya metšhelo.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowezi-2018 iqalisa ukusimamisa kanye nohlelo lukahulumeni lokuvusesela nokugqugquzela ukusimama komnotho, oluzosekelwa uzinzo lwesikhwamamali sikahulumeni kanye nolwezimali.

src: Mmušo o santše o ikgafile mo tlhabollong ya go swarelela ga ikonomi, eupša go bile le go folotša ga e sale go fiwa Polelo ya Tekanyetšokabo ya 2018 ka Dibokwane ngwaga wo.
tgt: Uhulumeni uqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekusimamiseni isikhawamamali sikahulumeni, kodwa kube nokuchezuka okuncane selokhu sethulwa kuSabelomali sowezi-2018 kuNhlolanja kulo nyaka.

src: Mmušo o santše o ikgafile go tiiša ikonomi le go fediša dikoloto.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokuzibophezela ekuzinziseni nasekwehliseni isikweletu sezwe.

src: Ge go bapetšwa seemo se se boima sa ikonomi le sa matlotlo, lekala leo le šišintšwego la letseno le gare le tšwelapele go bea pele mananeokgoparara a tšhomišo ya tšhelete setšhabeng ao a thekgago thuto ya motheo, maphelo, tlhabollo ya leago, meetse, kelelatšhila le ditirelo tša kabo ya mohlagase.
tgt: Njengoba kuncipha umthwalo osindayo kwezomnotho kanye nasesimweni sesikhwamamali sikahulumeni, ukwahlukaniswa kwengeniso okuphakanyiswayo kuyaqhubeka nokubeka eqhulwini izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali emphakathini njengemfundo eyisisekelo, ezempilo, ezenhlalakahle, amanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nezinsiza zikagesi.

src: Samiti ya Mopresidente ya Maphelo.
tgt: Ingqungquthela Yezempilo KaMongameli.

src: Kabinete e amogela dipoelo tša Samiti ya Mopresidente ya Maphelo yeo e nepilego go rarolla ditlhotlo tša go fapafapana tšeo di šetšanego le sistemo ya mmušo ya maphelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela imiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yezempilo KaMongameli ehlose ukudingida izinselele ezinhlobonhlobo eziqondene nohlelo lwezempilo lomphakathi.

src: Dipoelo tše di tla maatlafatša ditokišetšo tša go phethagatšwa ga Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Maphelo.
tgt: Imiphumela izoqinisa amalungiselelo okuqalisa uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (i-NHI).

src: Mpshafatšo ya naga.
tgt: Uguquko kwezomhlaba.

src: Kabinete e amogela phethagatšo ya go se fetogefetoge ya mpshafatšo ya naga le mananeo a pušetšo ya naga ao a rarollago mabošaedi a go tšea lehlakore a kgale le go thuša go godiša ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela ukuqaliswa kwezinhlelo zoguquko nokubuyiselwa komhlaba eziqhutshwa ngokulinganayo eziqondene nemisebenzi nokungalungi kwesikhathi esedlule futhi lisiza ukukhulisa umnotho.

src: Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o eteletše pele moletlo wa pušetšo ya naga fao dihektara tša go feta 4 586 tša naga di abetšwego badudi ba motsana wa KwaMkhwanazi go la Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natala.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uhole umcimbi wokubuyiswa komhlaba, lapho kunikezelwe ngamahektha ayizi-4 586 omhlaba emphakathini waKwaMkhwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Babudi ba KwaMkhwanazi ba tla fiwa gape thekgo le ditefo tša ka morago ga tefelo ya naga yeo ka botlalo go ba thuša go diriša lehumo la naga yeo ka botlalo.
tgt: Umphakathi waKwaMkhwanazi uzothola nezabelo ezilandela ukubuyiswa komhlaba kanye nokwesekwa okuzowusiza usebenzise yonke ingcebo ongase uyithole kulowa mhlaba.

src: Se se fetola badudi go tloga go balemi ba go lema feela gore ba iphediše go ba balemi ba go lemela kgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo go ralala magato ka moka a thoto nageng ya bona.
tgt: Lokhu kushintsha imiphakathi esebenzela ukuziphilisa ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo futhi ibe ngabanikazi bamabhizinisi kuyo yonke imisebenzi evela kwezolimo kanye nengcebo engatholakala emhlabeni wabo.

src: Mmušo o ikgafetše go thekga go swarelela lebaka le letelele ga dikgwebo tšeo di tšwelelago tša temo, tšeo di akaretšago diprotšeke tše 262 tša go amana le mpshafatšo ya naga go hola bafsa le basadi go ralala diprofense ka moka.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwesekeni ukusimamiswa kwamabhizinisi ezolimo aqubukayo, okubandakanya imisebenzi engama-262 ehambisana nokuguqulwa komhlaba ukuze kuhlomule intsha kanye nabantu besifazane kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

src: Tshenyo ya ditlabelo tša mmušo.
tgt: Ukubhidlizwa kwengqalasizinda yomphakathi.

src: Kabinete e laeditše matshwenyego a yona mo tshenyong ya ditlabelo tša dinamelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukukhathazeka ngokubhidlizwa kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha.

src: Se se bušetša morago boikgafo bja mmušo bja go iša ditirelo bathong bao ba bego ba phaetšwe ka thoko kua morago.
tgt: Lokhu kubukela phansi ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuhambiseni izinsiza emiphakathini eyayiphucwe amathuba ngaphambilini.

src: Le ge batho ba ka befelwa bjang goba bjang maitshwaro a bona ga a swanela go hlola tshenyo ya thoto ya mmušo.
tgt: Ayikho intukuthelo engasetshenziswa njengesizathu sokubhidliza impahla yomphakathi.

src: Tshenyo ya mohuta wo e hula bahloki ditirelo tšeo ba di hlokago kudu.
tgt: Lokhu kubhidlizwa kwempahla kuphuca abampofu inqwaba yezinsiza eziyizidingongqangi.

src: Kabinete e dira bopiletšo go maloko a setšhaba go ntšha mahlo dinameng le go šomišana le makoko a phethagatšo ya melao go golega bao ba nago le seabe gore ba ikarabele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi aqaphele futhi asebenzisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuze labo abaphula umthetho babhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gape gore Lekala la Toka, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Tšhireletšego le tla rarolla taba ye go ya ka tshepedišo ye maleba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde laveza ukuthi iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvikelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuvikela lizobhekana kanjani nalolu daba ngokufanele.

src: Tshepedišo ya thwalo ya Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Ditshekišo tša Mmušo (NDPP) Kabinete e amogela lemanoga le lefsa la go thwala Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Ditshekišo tša Mmušo (NDPP).
tgt: Inqubo yokuqokwa KukaMqondisi Wephiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi lamukele indlela entsha yokuqoka u-NDPUMongameli Ramaphosa uqoke Ithimba Labeluleki elizohlonza futhi libambe imposambuso nabantu abafanelekile ukuthi bangathatha isikhundla sokuba yiNhloko yoPhiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NPA).

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa o thwetše Sehlopha sa Baeletši go hlaola badiradikgopelo le go ba botšološa e le bao ba swanelago ke go lebelelwa go ka tsorama maemo a Hlogo ya Lekgotla la Bosekiši bja Bosetšhaba.
tgt: Ithimba lisebenze okokuqala kuleli sonto futhi kulindeleke ukuthi lithumele amagama abantu abakhethwe njengalabo abangase bafanelwe ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kuMongameli ngomhla ziyi-7 kuZibandlela 2018.

src: Sehlopha se sa Boeletši se dutše lekga la mathomothomo bekeng yona ye ebile go letetšwe gore le tla romela maina a bao ba hlokotšwego go Mopresidente pele ga la 7 Manthole Kahlolo ya Kgorotsheko ya Molaotheo.
tgt: Isinqumo Senkantolo YoMthethosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi lenze izethulo ngeSinqumo Senkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esiqondene nokusetshenziswa, ukulinywa nokuphathwa kwensangu ngabantu abadala ngasese bezisebenzisele ngokwabo kanye nomthelela wako.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile Kahlolo ya Kgorotsheko ya Molaotheo mabapi le tšhomišo, temo le go ba le lebake bathong ba bagolo mafelong a bona ka sephiring gore ba ka e šomiša, le ditlamorago tša yona.
tgt: Kucelwa ukuthi amalungu omphakathi azijwayeze lesi sinqumo njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwensangu emphakathini kungavumelekile.

src: Maloko a setšhaba a kgopelwa go itlwaetša kahlolo ye ka ge tšhomišo ya lebake mafelong a bohle e ileditšwe.
tgt: Phezu kwalokho, lesi sinqumo asikuqedanga ukuba yicala kokudayiswa kwensangu.2 IKhabhinethi lazisa ukuthi lesi sinqumo sisebenza phakathi kweminye imithetho engase isebenze maqondana nokusebenzisa, ukuphatha kanye nokutshala insangu.

src: Go feta mo, kahlolo ye ga e bee go gweba ka lebake molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lisabonisana nongoti ngalolu daba.

src: Samiti ya Polokego Dikolong.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni.

src: Kabinete e amogela Samiti ye bego e swerwe malobanyana mo ya Polokego Dikolong yeo e bego e swerwe ka fase ga boetapele bja Tona ya Thuto ya Motheo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukela iNgqungquthela Yezokuphepha Ezikoleni esanda kubanjwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo u-Angie Motshekga.

src: Samiti ye e kopantše mmogo baamegi ba thuto le ba kantle go hwetša ditharollo ditlhotlong tša polokego tšeo di lebaganego le dikolo tša naga ye gotee le go kgora ditsela go ya pele tša tikologo ya polokego dikolong.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganise ababambiqhaza kwezemfundo nabazimele ukuthola izisombululo ngezinkinga zezokuphepha eziqondene nezikole ezweni kanye nokusungula indlela ebheke phambili yokwakha izimo eziphephile esikoleni.

src: Se se latela ditiragalo tša dikgaruru dikolong tše dingwe, go akaretšwa lehu le sehlogo la morutiši wa mengwaga ye 24, Morena Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, yo a hlabilwego ka thipa go fihla a neela moya a hlaba ke morutwana wa Sekolo seo se Phagamego sa Ramotshere kua Zeerust, Leboa Bodikela.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela izigameko zodlame ezehle ezikoleni ezithile, okubandakanya ukubulawa ngesihluku kukathisha oneminyaka engama-24, uMnu.

src: Baamegi ka moka ba kwane gore dikgaruru ka botlalo, kudukudu dikolong, ga di amogelege le gatee le gore tšhomišanommogo ya goya pele e ya nyekega go netefatša gore dikolo di a bolokega go barutwana le barutiši ka bobedi ga bona.
tgt: Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, owabulawa ukugwazwa umfundi eRamotshere Secondary School eZeerust, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Kabinete e lakaletša barutwana ka moka mahlatse le mahlogonolo, kudukudu ba Mphato wa Marematlou, mo nakong ye ya ditlhahlobo.
tgt: Bonke ababambiqhaza bavuma ukuthi udlame jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, alwamukelekile nhlobo nokuthi kudingeka kuqhutshekwe nokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole ziba yindawo ephephile kubafundi nothisha.

src: Lekga la mathomothomo, kgoro e tlare wona ngwaga wo ya sepediša ditlhahlobo tša Polelo ka Diatla ya Afrika Borwa maemong e Leleme la Letswele go barutwana ba difoa ba 58 go ralala dikolo tše lesome.
tgt: Izivivinyo zikamatikuletsheni IKhabhinethi lifisela bonke abafundi, ikakhulukazi abafundi beBanga le-12, okumhlophe kulesi sikhathi.

src: Ditlhahlobo tše di gagaba lebaka la dibeke tše tlhano le seripa ebile di tla rungwa ka la 28 Dibatsela 2018.
tgt: Okokuqala ngqa, kulo nyaka uMnyango uzoba nesivivinyo sokuhlolela uLimi Lwezimpawu lwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SASL) ezingeni loLimi Lwasekhaya esizobhalwa abafundi abangama-58 abangezwa kahle ezikoleni eziyi-10.

src: Barutwana nageng ka bophara le bona ba tla saena boikano bja boithaopo go ikgafa go šireletša potego ya ditlhahlobo ka go se kgathe tema maitshwarong afe goba afe a go se loke.
tgt: Abafundi ezweni lonke bazosayina isifungo esingaphoqelekile sokuzinikela ukuhlonipha isithunzi sezivivinyo ngokungayephuli imibandela yezivivinyo.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba bana ba hlohleletšwa go thekga barutwana mo nakong ye ye boima mo leetong la bona la dithuto.
tgt: Abazali nababheki bezingane bakhuthazwa ukuthi babeseke abafundi ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi ohambweni lwabo lwezemfundo.

src: Go bohlokwa gape go hlohleletša barutwana go fetša dithuto tša bona.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokuthi kukhuthazwe abafundi ukuthi basiqede isikole.

src: Diphetho tša Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo ZeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše go tsebagatšwa ga Mafelo ao a Šireleditšwego a Mabopo a 20 (di-MPA) bjalo ka karolo ya Lesolo la Operation Phakisa: Netweke ya Boemedi ya di-MPA tša Ikonomi ya Mabopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukunqunywa kweziNdawo Zasolwandle Ezivikelekile (ama-MPA) ezingama-20 njengengxenye yeNethiwekhi Emelwe yama-MPA ye-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Mohola wa tsebagatšo ye ya tlaleletšo e tla, gare ga tše dingwe, ya dumelela tlhabollo ya goyapele ya boeti bja go tsamaišana le tlhago le tlhohleletšo ya khumanego ya methopo yeo e laolwago ka tsela ye swarelelago go bareaditlhaphi ba dikgwebo tše nnyane.
tgt: Umhlomulo womsebenzi ongenzelwe, phakathi kokunye, uzovumela ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezokuvakasha okuqondene nezemvelo kanye nokukhuthazwa kokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabadobi abadobela ukuziphilisa eziphethwe ngendlela esimamisayo.

src: Mafelo a tlaleletšo ao a šišintšwego a latetše ditherišano tše maleba le bakgathatema bao ba amegago.
tgt: Imisebenzi ehlongozwayo yazalwa izingxoxo zokubonisana nababambiqhaza abafanele.

src: Di-MPA di tlo phatlalatšwa ka Kuranteng ya Mmušo.
tgt: Ama-MPA azoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše Lenaneo la Afrika Borwa la Bosetšhaba la Magato ao a Sekasekilwego le go Tsepamišwa (NAP) go Lwantšha Phedišo ya Dithokgwa, go Gwahlafala ga Naga le go Fediša Komelelo (2018-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze uHlelo Lwemisebenzi Kazwelonke (i-NAP) Yesibili Olubuyekeziwe Noluhambisanayo lweNingizimu Afrika ukuNqanda Ukwanda Kwezindawo Eziwugwadule, Ukumoshakala Komhlaba kanye Nokungenelela kuMthelela Wesomiso (2018-2030).

src: NAP e šeditše go kgatha tema mo pabalelong le tšhomišong ye swarelelago ya naga ya rena le didirišwa tše dingwe tša tlhago.
tgt: I-NAP ihlose ukuba nomthelela ekugcineni nasekusetshenzisweni ngendlela esimeme komhlaba wethu kanye nezinye izinsiza zemvelo.

src: Afrika borwa e dumeletše kopano sa Ditšhabakopano ya go lwantšha Phedišo ya Dithokgwa ka 1997.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yavumelana ngokusemthethweni neSivumelwano Sokunqanda Ukwakheka Kogwadule kweNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe (i-UN) ngowe-1997.

src: Ka go tsamaišana le Sengwalwa sa 9 sa Kopano ye, go nyakega gore bakgathatema ba tšweletše, ba lokiše le go phethagatša magato a NAP bjalo ka kgwekgwe ya taba ya leanophethagatšo la go lwantšha phedišo ya dithokgwa le go fediša ditlamorago tša komelelo.
tgt: NgokweSiqephu 9 sesivumelwano, abathintekayo kumele basungule, balungise futhi baqalise i-NAP njengesakhi esibaluleke kakhulu sesu lokunqanda ukuqedwa kwamahlathi futhi kungenelelwe emtheleleni wesomiso.

src: Afrika Borwa e tšweleditše magato a yona a NAP ka 2004.Melaokakanywa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yasungula i-NAP yayo yokuqala ngowe-2004.IMithethosivivinywa.
